stories.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash, a 552-billion-parameter model with MIT-licensed weights and cut prices
stories.reason: The model shrank its KV cache to a quarter of its predecessor's size while cutting API prices to $0.15 per million input tokens, and processed a trillion tokens in its first 24 hours -- a sign Chinese labs keep closing the frontier gap on cost and efficiency.

stories.title: Malicious .git configs can make Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Cursor run attacker code, researchers find
stories.reason: Startup Accomplish found the coding agents don't directly breach their sandboxes but exploit files the agent itself creates that trusted host tools later run; Cursor and OpenAI patched within a week, while Anthropic took roughly 50 days and 30 releases.

stories.title: Trump says he'd 'love to see' a unified Ireland during Dublin visit built around his golf tournament
stories.reason: The comment on one of Ireland and the UK's most politically sensitive questions came during talks with President Catherine Connolly and PM Micheal Martin, ahead of Trump heading to his Doonbeg course.

stories.title: BRICS adopts New Delhi Declaration as Modi proposes a 'Troika' mechanism for institutional continuity
stories.reason: Marking the bloc's 20th anniversary, Modi's push for a secure digital repository and rotating-chair continuity plan aims to make BRICS decisions stick despite the sharp rifts among members over the region's overlapping wars.

stories.title: Wall Street snaps a four-day losing streak as CPI comes in as expected and oil retreats from $108
stories.reason: The Dow and Nasdaq each rose about 1% as Brent crude fell nearly 3% to $104, even as sticky core inflation cemented bets that the Fed will still raise rates at next week's meeting.

stories.title: At least 76,000 flee fighting in Yemen since July as Houthi offensive routs government forces
stories.reason: The UN says displacement quadrupled in the past week alone as Houthi forces swept through Mocha and the Red Sea coast, with aid officials warning of a rapidly worsening crisis as families flee for a second or third time with nothing left.

stories.title: Lebanon's President Aoun makes rare visit to Nabatiyeh, pledges to secure Israeli withdrawal
stories.reason: Aoun's first visit to the south since the war began comes days after Israel seized and demolished part of the Ali Taher ridge despite a US-brokered ceasefire, and as talks to resolve the standoff have just been pushed back to October.

stories.title: Cognition launches SWE-2, a coding model matching frontier performance at up to 70% lower cost
stories.reason: Built by scaling reinforcement learning to a multi-trillion-parameter regime on Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, SWE-2 lands within a point of rival frontier models on coding evals, intensifying price competition in AI-assisted software engineering.
